name: streetify-monorepo
description: Streetify - Sri Lankan Urban Ride-Hailing Platform

scripts.backend: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (-not $env:JAVA_HOME) { $jdks = Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\Java\jdk*', 'C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk*', ($env:USERPROFILE + '\.jdks\*') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($jdks) { $env:JAVA_HOME = ($jdks | Select-Object -First 1).FullName } }; cd streetify-backend; .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run"
scripts.build:backend: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (-not $env:JAVA_HOME) { $jdks = Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\Java\jdk*', 'C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk*', ($env:USERPROFILE + '\.jdks\*') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($jdks) { $env:JAVA_HOME = ($jdks | Select-Object -First 1).FullName } }; cd streetify-backend; .\mvnw.cmd clean package -DskipTests"
